mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in FEDFUNDS signals monetary easing, leading to lower discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in CPIAUCSL above 235 triggers expectations of tighter monetary policy, reducing growth prospects and causing negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If the actual 20-day returns are positive despite the CPIAUCSL crossing above 235, or the effect fades within 20 days.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in FEDFUNDS and decline in GDPC1 signals tightening monetary policy and weakening demand, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If the interaction does not occur or 20-day returns are positive despite the signals.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a sustained decline in FEDFUNDS amplifies positive 20d S&P 500 returns as investors anticipate reduced rate hikes.
failure_condition: If not in late-cycle expansion or returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite the signal.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in employment (PAYEMS) and decline in demand (GDPC1) indicates labor market strength without growth, causing investor uncertainty and negative 60-day returns.
failure_condition: If the interaction does not occur or returns are positive despite the signals.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in UNRATE above 7.0% triggers concerns about labor market tightness, reducing growth expectations and causing negative 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If returns are positive despite the UNRATE crossing above 7.0% or the effect is short-lived.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in INDPRO signals robust supply-side growth, boosting corporate profits and equity valuations, leading to positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If supply growth stalls or returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite the signal.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery, rising INDPRO amplifies positive 20-day S&P 500 returns as businesses invest more in capital expenditures.
failure_condition: If not in post-shock recovery or returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite the signal.
